sidebar.profileHint: Default profile for chats (locked chats keep theirs)

home.favHint: Star characters to see them here

general.title: General
general.lead: App-wide preferences. Chat and Phone settings live in their own tabs.
general.checkUpdateDesc: Check GitHub releases for a newer version. Download manually from the release page.
general.checkOnStartDesc: Check GitHub once when the app starts and notify if an update is available.

budget.title: Budget
budget.lead: Monthly budget limits per API profile, usage totals, and model pricing table.
budget.noUsage: No API usage in this period
budget.priceHint: Set per-model pricing to display estimated costs next to usage.

lorebook.title: Lorebook
lorebook.lead: Configure World Info keyword scan depth and recursive activation depth.
lorebook.scanDepthDesc: Number of recent chat messages to scan for World Info keywords (1–200, default 2). Current user input is always included.
lorebook.maxDepthDesc: Maximum depth for recursively scanning activated World Info entries (0–10, 0 disables recursion).

chatSec.title: Chat
chatSec.lead: Preferences for the chat screen and new conversations.
chatSec.sendOnEnterDesc: When off, send with Ctrl+Enter. Shift+Enter always inserts a newline.
chatSec.notifyEnabledDesc: Only when the app is in the background. Shows completion only without chat text.
chatSec.apiDesc: Used when not overridden in conversation settings.
chatSec.presetDesc: Used when conversation preset is set to App Default.
chatSec.personaDesc: Used when a character has no default persona.

themeSec.title: Theme
themeSec.modeDesc: Follow system appearance or choose manually.
themeSec.accentDesc: Used for buttons, selections, and highlights unless overridden by a theme.
themeSec.grayToneDesc: Base neutral tint for backgrounds, borders, and text.
themeSec.fontSizeDesc: Base font size across the app.
themeSec.framelessDesc: Use the custom app header instead of the OS titlebar.
themeSec.showTimestampsDesc: Show message timestamps in chat (custom theme settings take precedence).
themeSec.showAvatarsDesc: Show profile avatars next to messages in chat.
themeSec.charFrameDesc: Display shape for character profile images in chat.
themeSec.userFrameDesc: Display shape for your persona profile images in chat.
themeSec.multiCharAvatarsDesc: Replace `Name: dialogue` prefixes with matching character avatars.
themeSec.bgDesc: Background image for chat screens (supports GIF, copied to app data).
themeSec.bgScrimHint: Higher makes text clearer; lower shows the background more vividly.
themeSec.bgScrimColorDesc: Tint color over the background (defaults to current theme background).
themeSec.snippetHint: Saved and applied when you leave the input field.

shortcutSec.title: Shortcuts
shortcutSec.lead: Currently available keyboard shortcuts. Custom rebinding is coming soon.

apiSec.title: API Keys
apiSec.lead: AI provider connections. Keys are stored securely in your OS keychain.
apiSec.emptyDesc: Add an API connection to start chatting with AI.

presetSec.title: Presets
presetSec.lead: Prompt block layout and generation parameters sent to AI.
presetSec.emptyDesc: Create a new preset or import a SillyTavern preset (.json).

regexSec.title: Regex
regexSec.lead: Find and replace message text. Applied in order from top to bottom.
regexSec.emptyDesc: Create a new script or import a SillyTavern regex (.json).

activitySec.title: Recent Activity
activitySec.lead: AI, speech, and image API tasks and usage. Token counts are reported by the provider or estimated.

logSec.title: Logs
logSec.lead: Errors and notices from this session (including failed AI/TTS/image tasks). Cleared on exit.
logSec.emptyDesc: Errors and notifications will appear here.
logSec.noPanics: No crash logs recorded. Crash logs stay local and are never sent externally.

gameSec.title: Game Mode
gameSec.lead: Rules prepended by the app to game conversations (NPC & scene inputs), always placed before game data.
gameSec.gameRulesDesc: Prepended to 1:1 NPC chats. One rule per line. Lines with <updateRel> are omitted in scene inputs.
gameSec.sceneRulesDesc: Additional rules for scene inputs. One rule per line.

cgSec.title: Character Assets
cgSec.lead: Let AI display character assets at fitting moments using <cg>key</cg> tags.
cgSec.groupVariantsDesc: Merge smile.png, smile-1.png, smile-2.png under one key `smile`. Shown once to AI and picked randomly per message.
cgSec.promptDesc: Included only when chatting with characters that have image keys.

phoneSec.title: Phone
phoneSec.lead: Settings for messenger chats on the Phone screen (same as the Phone right-panel Info tab).

translateSec.title: Translate
translateSec.lead: Translate AI replies into your language and your input into another language using a chat AI.
translateSec.apiDesc: A fast, inexpensive model is usually sufficient.
translateSec.modelDesc: Leave empty to use the API's default model.
translateSec.inputLangDesc: Used by 'Translate input' in the composer + menu.
translateSec.autoTranslateDesc: Automatically translate incoming replies (you can toggle back to the original).
translateSec.promptDesc: Instructions sent when translating AI replies, user input, and game lines.

lintSec.title: Message Linter
lintSec.lead: Checks replies locally before saving (no API cost). Originals are preserved if auto-fixed. Does not run during streaming.
lintSec.unclosedDesc: Unclosed tags (<b>), code blocks (```), bold (**), italic (*), or quotes. Auto-fix appends closing tokens.
lintSec.repeatDesc: Duplicate paragraphs within one reply. Auto-fix removes duplicates.
lintSec.stuckDesc: Endless word/phrase repetition glitches. Auto-fix trims to at most two repeats.
lintSec.impersonateDesc: Lines starting with 'UserName: ...'. Auto-fix truncates from that line.
lintSec.bannedListDesc: Press Enter or comma to add (up to 100). Separate from Auto Rewrite's banned list.

memorySec.title: Memory Search
memorySec.lead: Search past conversations semantically. Runs only when you click index/search and may incur embedding API costs.
memorySec.embedApiDesc: Configured separately from chat API. Required for indexing and search.
memorySec.tokenCapDesc: Estimated input tokens per indexing run. Prompts for confirmation if exceeded.
memorySec.prefixDesc: Only for models like e5/nomic that require prefixes. Re-index after changing.
memorySec.indexAllDesc: Review conversation count and estimated tokens before starting.
memorySec.statusDesc: Stored locally in memory.db (excluded from backups and sync).

summarySec.title: Chat Summary
summarySec.lead: Automatically summarizes older messages that fall outside the context window (incurs API cost).
summarySec.modelDesc: Leave empty to use the API's default model.
summarySec.promptDesc: Instructions sent when summarizing older conversation history.

rewriteSec.title: Auto Rewrite
rewriteSec.lead: Generates a new swipe when banned words or repetition glitches are detected (incurs extra API cost per retry).
rewriteSec.bannedDesc: Regenerate if any word below appears (separate from Message Linter's list).
rewriteSec.bannedListDesc: Press Enter or comma to add (up to 100, case-insensitive).

ghostSec.title: Ghostwrite
ghostSec.lead: Expands your draft into dialogue in your persona's voice inside the input box without sending (incurs API cost per click).
ghostSec.modelDesc: Leave empty to use the API's default model.
ghostSec.promptDesc: Default instruction appended to ghostwrite requests.

ttsSec.title: Text-to-Speech
ttsSec.lead: Read AI replies aloud using ElevenLabs or an OpenAI-compatible speech API.
ttsSec.apiDesc: Create an 'ElevenLabs (Speech)' connection in API Keys first.

imageGenSec.title: Image Generation
imageGenSec.lead: Generate images from chat scenes or custom prompts using NovelAI or an OpenAI-compatible API.
imageGenSec.apiDesc: Create a 'NovelAI (Image)' connection in API Keys first.
imageGenSec.promptApiDesc: Chat AI that converts scenes into image prompts (uses tags for NovelAI).
imageGenSec.aiPromptDesc: When off, sends the raw message text directly as the prompt.
imageGenSec.presetRowDesc: Upload an AI image to extract its generation settings as a preset (#preset tag).
imageGenSec.qualityDesc: NovelAI quality tags appended to the end of prompts.

widgetSec.title: Widgets
widgetSec.autostartDesc: Start only the desktop widget automatically when you sign in.

quickReplySec.title: Quick Reply
quickReplySec.lead: Manage quick reply buttons above the input bar and / slash command sets.
quickReplySec.name: Name
quickReplySec.autoSendDesc: When on, clicking sends immediately (incurs AI cost); when off, fills the input box only.
quickReplySec.aiLimitDesc: Max AI calls (e.g. /gen) per script run (1–{max}). Higher values may incur extra API costs.
quickReplySec.emptyDesc: Create a new set or import a SillyTavern Quick Reply set (.json).

syncSec.title: Sync
syncSec.lead: Exchange and merge characters, chats, and settings across devices (API keys are never shared).
syncSec.rollbackMsg: Restores the DB and settings snapshot from {date}. Changes made on this device afterward will be lost (current data is safely moved to restore-backups). Auto-sync will be disabled, and the app will restart.
syncSec.excludeMsg: Stop waiting for {device} and clean up deletion history. If that device returns later, a full re-merge will occur and deleted items may reappear.
syncSec.drivePermError: Failed to obtain Google Drive permission
syncSec.driveConnectError: Could not connect to Google Drive
syncSec.driveLogoutMsg: Sign out of Google on this device and revoke access. Sync data on Drive stays intact for other devices.
syncSec.driveWipeMsg: Deletes the Sandcastle app folder on Google Drive (sync files and images for all devices) and disconnects this device. Local data stays intact, but Drive data cannot be recovered.
syncSec.driveWiped: Deleted {count} sync files on Drive and disconnected
syncSec.cellularMsg: You are not on Wi-Fi. Sync using mobile data? (May use significant data if you have many images.)
syncSec.syncNoChanges: Synced: no new changes from other devices
syncSec.returnedExcluded: A previously excluded device returned and triggered a full merge. Please review in case deleted items were restored.
syncSec.dropOpenHint: Sandcastle sync (.scsync) up to 300MB. Use the Open button for larger files.
syncSec.statUpdatedHint: Items edited only on the other device
syncSec.statDeletedHint: Deleted on the other device and unchanged here
syncSec.statRestoredHint: Deleted here but edited on the other device (kept the edit)
syncSec.statKeptLocalHint: Deleted on the other device but edited here
syncSec.statConflictsHint: Edited on both devices; local is kept and incoming is saved for review
syncSec.statBranchesHint: Both devices continued the same chat; incoming saved as a new branch
syncSec.statFilesAddedHint: Images & files missing on this device
syncSec.statFilesMissingHint: Not included in bundle — re-export with 'Include images & files' enabled
syncSec.statFilesKeptLocalHint: Different file at the same path; local file preserved
syncSec.pendingRollbackDesc: Restart the app to restore the pre-merge snapshot.
syncSec.storageDesc: Devices exchange and merge sync bundles through a shared location.
syncSec.syncFolderDesc: Pick a folder synced by OneDrive, Dropbox, or Google Drive; Sandcastle creates a sandcastle-sync subfolder inside it.
syncSec.driveUnavailable: Google Drive sync is not included in this build (available in release builds). Use Folder Sync or manual file exchange instead.
syncSec.driveConnectedDesc: {who} · Uses only the app-private Drive folder (cannot access your other files).
syncSec.driveLoginDescPhone: Authorize with your Google account on this phone. Access is limited to the app-private Drive folder.
syncSec.driveLoginDescDesktop: Sign in to Google in your browser. Access is limited to the app-private Drive folder, and credentials stay in this device's keychain.
syncSec.syncNowDesc: Pull and merge updates from other devices, then upload yours. Creates a local DB/settings snapshot before merging.
syncSec.autoSyncDesc: Syncs once on startup and at the chosen interval while the app is open (no API cost).
syncSec.wifiOnlyDesc: Runs auto-sync only on Wi-Fi and prompts before manual sync on cellular.
syncSec.includeFilesDesc: When off, exports records and settings only (the receiver will see how many files are missing).
syncSec.createBundleDesc: Includes characters, chats, lorebooks, presets, games, and shared settings (excludes logs, trash, and device-only settings).
syncSec.openBundleDesc: Previews changes before merging and creates a local snapshot automatically.
syncSec.settingsAppliedNote: Shared settings (theme, language, prompts, etc.) will be updated. Device-only settings (API selection, toggles, font size) stay unchanged.
syncSec.conflictsNote: Conflicting items currently show your local version while incoming versions are saved in 'Conflicts' above for review.
syncSec.rollbackGroupDesc: Automatic snapshots taken before merges (last 3). Selecting one restores it on next restart.

communitySec.title: Community Plugins
communitySec.lead: Install plugins from files and manage their permissions and settings.
communitySec.wrongUpdateId: Different plugin ({found}) — not an update for ''{expected}''
communitySec.updatedDisabled: Plugin updated (disabled — toggle on to approve permissions)
communitySec.installedDisabled: Plugin installed (disabled — toggle on below to enable)
communitySec.deleteMsg: Moves to Trash. If restored, it will remain disabled (with saved data intact).
communitySec.switchedVersion: Switched to version {version} (disabled — toggle on to approve permissions)
communitySec.installZipDesc: A zip file containing manifest.json. You can inspect contents and permissions before installing.
communitySec.installFolderDesc: Load a local plugin folder directly for development.
communitySec.proposalsDesc: Changes proposed by plugins to characters or lorebooks. Nothing changes until you review and approve.
communitySec.emptyDesc: Choose a zip file or folder to install. See the docs for how to build plugins.
communitySec.codeChangedMsg: Files in the plugin folder changed since it was last enabled. Verify the changes before turning it back on.
communitySec.processModeHint: Notes only: attaches notes below replies. Auto-fix: modifies reply text (original is kept with revert option).
communitySec.aiAutoDesc: When off, this plugin can only call AI from user-triggered commands and prompts for confirmation in panels. When on, hooks may call AI automatically (incurs API cost within budget).

activityDetail.logEnabled: Now saving AI request/response logs on this device
activityDetail.clearLogsMsg: Deletes all saved AI request/response logs (task history and usage stats remain intact).
activityDetail.retentionMsg: Deletes task history and detailed usage older than {days} days on startup. Per-API usage totals and budget calculations remain intact. This cannot be undone.
activityDetail.nothingToCompact: No old records to clean up
activityDetail.emptyDesc: Sending messages or using translate, TTS, or image generation will appear here.

budgetDetail.clearMsg: Clears per-API usage totals. Activity history stays, but per-task token counts are removed. Current month text calls for budgeted profiles are preserved for limit tracking.
budgetDetail.estimatedTotalHint: (based on price table; actual billing may differ)
budgetDetail.estimatedCallsTitle: Calls where the provider omitted usage are estimated from character count
budgetDetail.subscriptionHint: Subscription provider — shows remaining account quota instead of a spending cap.
budgetDetail.noPriceWarn: Price unknown for this model. Add it to the Price Table below to enforce a budget limit.
budgetDetail.legacyLimitWarn: Legacy monthly token limit ({tokens}) is no longer used. Setting a dollar limit above clears it.
budgetDetail.unpricedWarn: {count} calls lacked pricing and are excluded from this total.

more.memRecallScopeDesc: 'All chats' may pull memories from conversations with other characters or personas.

more.memRecallTopKDesc: Only top-scoring chunks are kept, so fewer may be injected.

more2.dropPresetImgHint: PNG, JPG, WEBP (extracts AI generation metadata if present)
more2.noGenMetaToast: No generation metadata found; added to preset list only
more2.noPresetsHint: None yet — open an image in the Images page and tag it #preset
more2.autoImageDesc: Instructs the writing AI to append <image>prompt</image> at the end of replies for automatic generation (incurs image cost per reply).
more2.autoImageVars: Inserted where {{auto_image}} is placed in preset blocks
more2.imagePromptNaiDesc: NovelAI: instructions for converting a scene into Danbooru tags
more2.imagePromptDesc: Instructions for converting a scene into an English image prompt
more2.typeModelMsg: Saved under "Custom Models" for this API profile.
more2.noModelsHint: No models to show. Use ··· on the right to enter one manually or fetch from provider.
more2.reasoningDesc: Higher reasoning effort produces more thorough replies, but takes longer and uses more tokens.
more2.deleteFontMsg: Remove ''{name}'' from the list and delete its copied file? (Your original file stays untouched.)

more2.fontMgrLead: Assign UI, reading text, and monospace fonts and manage uploaded font files.
more2.uiFontDesc: Used for menus, buttons, titles, and app chrome
more2.textFontDesc: Used for chat messages, reader view, and character descriptions
more2.monoFontDesc: Used for code blocks, logs, regex, and monospace editors
more2.pvUiSample: Buttons and sidebar menu preview · Sandcastle 0.3
more2.pvTextSample: “The wind drifted through the forest as a quiet night fell.” The quick brown fox 123.
more2.noUploadedFonts: No uploaded fonts yet. Upload TTF, OTF, WOFF, or WOFF2 files or drop them here.

more3.invalidSaFile: Not a service account key file (requires type: service_account)
more3.apiKeyLead: Keys are stored securely in your operating system keychain.
more3.name: Name
more3.saReloadHint: Reload the key file to change location or project
more3.saConsoleHint: Download from Google Cloud Console → IAM → Service Accounts → Add Key (JSON)

presetEditor.utilPromptsHint: Applies only to this preset. Leave blank to inherit global app prompts.
presetEditor.blocksHint: Sent in top-to-bottom order. App system rules always come first.

mascot.pairChatAiDesc: Uses linked API & character info (falls back to default lines on failure)

dataSec.createBackupDesc: Bundle characters, chats, settings, images, gallery, backgrounds, and games into one file (excludes API keys).
dataSec.restoreBackupDesc: Moves current data safely aside before restoring. The app will restart.
dataSec.importStDesc: Import a zipped data/default-user folder (up to 10GB).
dataSec.exportStDesc: Exports character cards, chats, lorebooks, presets, personas, and regex (excludes Game & Phone).
dataSec.dbCheckDesc: Checks DB integrity and scans for unused files in character folders without deleting anything.
